donors.fix: GameImpl.createSimulationForPlayableCalc copies the game with a thread-local flag set; the copy constructor then shares the parent's card objects and lists their ids in sharedGameCards, and a card is deep-copied on its first read (getCard, getCards, the state-based sweep). Same map capacity and iteration order as the eager copy. No Rules behaviour and no card data change.
